about: The one introduction lifecycle (src/introduction-states.mjs): a community's matches (src/community-matching.mjs) and the Network's requests (src/network.mjs, src/network-first-matches.mjs) move between these states only along next, and every view shows a state with its says, the same words for both people. A community match is proposed, then one_yes, and makes its shared space only when everyone said yes (waiting_for_ais); passed or expired end it.

proposed.says: Trillion thinks you two should meet. Nothing has been sent yet.

one_yes.says: Waiting for everyone to answer. Trillion makes the introduction once everyone says yes.

sent.says: Asked to meet. No answer yet.

accepted.says: Both said yes. You can talk in the pursuit you now share.

declined.says: You chose not to meet this time.

waiting_for_ais.says: Trillion introduced you. Your AIs are finding what you could talk about first.

introduced.says: Trillion introduced you, with a few things to talk about first.

talked.says: You have both written in your shared pursuit.

passed.says: Passed. Trillion will not suggest this again.

expired.says: Nobody answered in time, so this introduction ended.

words.cannot_move: An introduction cannot move from {from} to {to}.
